content: {"episode_id":"ep-05122","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-50","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-50 determination that Mobile Cardiac Telemetry (CPT 93229) was not medically necessary for this episode. The clinical indication note documents a history of atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10) with intermittent episodes of palpitations (R00.2) accompanied by dizziness and giddiness (R42). Per the ordering note, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and to assess for ischemic changes in the context of known coronary artery disease. These documented indications meet the clinical criteria for this diagnostic modality, and we request reconsideration and payment of the outstanding balance of 495.93."}
